title: Pre-scrolling the grouped window tool tip to the final entry leaves part of the delegate out of view
line: The grouped window tooltip now opens scrolled to the active window on multi-screen setups, even the first time it is shown.
explanation: The grouped tooltip's maximumWidth was Screen.desktopAvailableWidth, the width of the whole desktop across all screens, and maximumHeight used that same width by mistake. With more than one screen the list was first laid out at that provisional size (2296 px instead of 1016 px on the rig) and positioned at the active window, then the tooltip was shrunk to fit its screen without re-positioning, so the active window ended up partly or fully out of view; vertical panels hit the same through the height. Later shows reuse the final size, which is why it only happens sometimes. The maximum width and height now come from the tooltip's own screen (Screen.width/Screen.height), so the list is laid out at its final size from the start.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: limit grouped tooltip to its own screen size

The grouped tooltip's maximum size used the width of the whole desktop,
so with several screens it was first laid out too wide, then shrunk to
the screen, leaving the active window out of view. Use the screen size.

BUG: 522287

From 457f834da59332ddfeb33bff4fd0afe33e8aadd4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 05:12:34 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: limit grouped tooltip to its own screen
 size

The grouped tooltip's maximum size used the width of the whole desktop,
so with several screens it was first laid out too wide, then shrunk to
the screen, leaving the active window out of view. Use the screen size.

BUG: 522287
---
 applets/taskmanager/qml/ToolTipDelegate.qml | 4 ++--
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ToolTipDelegate.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ToolTipDelegate.qml
index 014e954c5c..11ba6bf553 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ToolTipDelegate.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ToolTipDelegate.qml
@@ -91,8 +91,8 @@ Loader {
         PlasmaComponents3.ScrollView {
             id: scrollView
             // 2 * Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing is for the margin of tooltipDialog
-            readonly property real maximumWidth: Screen.desktopAvailableWidth - 2 * Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
-            readonly property real maximumHeight: Screen.desktopAvailableWidth - 2 * Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+            readonly property real maximumWidth: Screen.width - 2 * Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+            readonly property real maximumHeight: Screen.height - 2 * Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
 
             implicitWidth: {
                 // when vertical, all delegates have the same fixed width, but with an extra
--

media.caption: Two screens, bottom panel, first hover after opening 15 windows: the list stops at Image 09-11, the active Image 15 is out of view
Same steps with the fix: the list ends at the active Image 15, fully visible
Two screens, left panel: the vertical list opens at Image 04-07, the active Image 15 is out of view
Same steps with the fix: the tooltip fits the screen height and ends at the active Image 15

review.text: A two-line fix of the actual cause: the maximum size came from the whole desktop's width, and the height used a width by mistake, so on multi-screen setups the list was laid out too wide and then shrunk without re-positioning. Using the tooltip's own screen size is the minimal correct change, matches GroupDialog.qml, and the before/after shots for bottom and left panels show the active window fully in view.
